content: {"like":["Enjoys strong, character-driven performances in classic period dramas like Madame X","Values witty, well-crafted dialogue in British comedies such as Are You Being Served?","Appreciates well-executed sword fights and humor in period thrillers like The Scarlet Pimpernel","Prefers faithful, complete series releases that preserve original episode content, e.g., Alf Season 4","Loves comedic adaptations of Shakespeare that are laugh-out-loud and well-produced"],"dislike":["Dislikes shallow, one-dimensional character portrayals in action films like Speed 2","Rejects plot twists that feel forced or unrealistic in horror‑comedy hybrids like Hush…Hush, Sweet Charlotte","Criticizes poorly executed villain portrayals in action thrillers, e.g., Willem Dafoe in Speed 2","Finds pacing issues and plot stretches in family‑friendly series finales, e.g., Project: ALF","Dislikes cuts that remove dialogue or scenes, compromising narrative integrity, as with Lions Gate Alf release"]}
